programme.desc: Als watersproeiers plotseling hun voetbalwedstrijd onderbreken moeten Chelsea en haar vriendjes schuilen in een klein speelhuisje.

programme.title: Enchantimals™ Verhalen uit Everwilde
programme.desc: Wanneer de supergeorganiseerde en nette Felicity en de brutale, impulsieve Sage besluiten om samen een van Bree's recepten te bakken, is het resultaat allesbehalve smakelijk.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training...

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China.In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui...

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Foodwise：Qingdao
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Qingdao, China's beer mecca by the sea. With red tiles and green trees that make up the city's stunning scenery, our hosts embark on another foodie-journey with local delicacies and interesting guest appearances. From drinking beer with a German friend, catching crabs by the ocean and devouring grilled eel the classic Korean way, this episode will leave you hungry for more!

programme.title: A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade
programme.desc: The documentary "A Canopy of Umbrellas, a Sichuan Serenade" follows a father and son as they carry forward the centuries-old craft of making Luzhou oil-paper umbrellas. Each umbrella tells a story—not only of skill, but of family and cultural resilience. As part of CGTN’s original series "Next Stop: China," this episode journeys into the lush bamboo forests of Sichuan, where traditional craftsmanship finds new life in the modern world.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China.In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui...

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below...

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along...

programme.title: The Yak and the Nomad
programme.desc: Qinghai’s Yushu Prefecture is one of China’s key yak-producing regions. This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. Trekking into the far-flung pastoral corners of the plateau, we listened closely to the stories behind the hurdles and hopes of pastoral life and development.

Part of CGTN’s original series “Next Stop: China,” this episode uncovers how strength, skill, and resilience connect athletes across city streets and endless grasslands, carrying forward a legacy that transcends geography and generations.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-4 Medieval Combat
programme.desc: Episode 4 centres on Shanghai, where Eastern and Western martial traditions meet in surprising ways. Kleber visits local practitioners of Historical European Martial Arts (HEMA), trying German and Italian longsword techniques first-hand and seeing how Chinese enthusiasts innovate by combining European swordsmanship with ancient Chinese military manuals.The episode also follows the rise of BUHURT, a European-style armored combat sport now gaining traction in China, featuring locally made traditional Chinese armour in intense full-contact bouts. Through Kleber’s own multicultural martial arts studio and the city’s everyday East-West blend, the episode shows Shanghai as a global hub, a...

This trip took us to Nangqian County, where we explored the yak industry that lies at the heart of Tibetan herders’ daily lives. programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Hung Ga and Choy Li Fut
programme.desc: In Foshan, China, Kleber meets with two masters of southern Chinese martial arts. He learns from a Hung Ga master that while this kungfu style is often associated with brute force, it’s actually a combination of hard and soft techniques that can also be used in traditional Chinese massage. Next, Kleber meets a master of Choy Li Fut, a kungfu style that utilizes everyday items such as towels, fans and even abacuses, and discovers the link between martial arts and lion dance.

programme.title: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade: A Traditional Chinese Silk Craft
programme.desc: Nanjing Yunjin Brocade, a traditional Chinese silk handicraft with a history spanning over 1,600 years, derives its name from its radiant and resplendent hues, which resemble clouds in the sky. Renowned for its exquisite materials, meticulous weaving techniques, and vibrant, splendid patterns, Yunjin Brocade is hailed as the "king of brocades." It represents the pinnacle of Chinese silk weaving techniques, encapsulates the essence of Chinese silk craftsmanship, and stands as a brilliant crystallization of China’s silk culture. The core technique of Yunjin Brocade weaving—known as "weaving through the warp and cutting the weft"—is executed manually by two artisans working above and below...

programme.title: China Untapped: Huzhou
programme.desc: Located in the east of China, on the south shore of Taihu Lake, Huzhou has been well-known for its richness in resources and blooming in silk trade since the ancient times. Guided by the concept of "lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets", Huzhou now is committed to developing green industries. In this episode, CGTN hosts Tianran He and Hannah Wilson travelled to Huzhou, where they tried a variety of guesthouse hotels in the Moganshan Mountains; experienced the life of digital nomads in Anji’s countryside; learned about the eco-concepts behind China's traditional architectures in Nanxun Ancient Town; and explored the development of eco-agriculture powered by high-tech along...

programme.title: Foodwise: Wuzhen

Foodie Tianran and art-lover Eva are accompanied by ubiquitous local street food, daily carnival performances and meet and greets with fascinating personalities. programme.title: Foodwise：Eating Global in Beijing
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in search of global cuisines that can be found in Beijing, the 3000-year old capital of China. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council.The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been...

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Foodwise: Xi'an
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy.From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty,...

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history.Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode...

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been...

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: Foodwise: Quanzhou
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May are in Quanzhou, the ancient starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. From its covered arcades and Roman columns to its Southeast Asian vibe, our hosts discover that Quanzhou truly is a melting pot of world cultures. Then there’s the food: From the local noodle porridge that utilizes Silk Road spices, to fried vinegar pork and a dessert made from a special algae, there’s plenty of unique dishes to try here. Over a cup of oolong, our hosts will discover how Quanzhou’s tea changed the world, and how trade with Arab civilizations influenced a local fishing village. So join us in Quanzhou, a city that UNESCO designated as an “Emporium of the World”!

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-5 Xingyi Quan
programme.desc: In Episode 5, Kleber travels to Shanxi, the birthplace of Xingyi Quan. He follows Master Cao Bing, a traditional Xingyi Quan teacher and modern combat coach, from Taiyuan’s noodle shops to Pingyao’s ancient streets, and from centuries-old vinegar breweries to Guandi temples, exploring Xingyi Quan’s deep links to Shanxi’s merchant culture and history.Master Cao breaks down the core principles of the “Five Elements and Twelve Forms”, and shows in his modern gym how techniques found in Muay Thai and Jiu-Jitsu can be integrated without losing Xingyi Quan’s philosophical core, guided by the mindset of taking only what is essential. Set against ancient sites such as Yongle Palace, this episode...

programme.title: All About the Yak
programme.desc: In this episode, we go to Nangqian, Yushu, Qinghai Province, to get close contact with the Yak in Tibet, which is known as the " Vehicle on the Plateau". During the bustling yak culture festival, people gather from near and far, meadows are crowded, and yak appraisal activities are also in full swing. As the journey continues, we are able to understand several aspects of the yak culture which is closely related to the life of Tibetan people.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Taiji Quan
programme.desc: Kleber travels to Chenjiagou in central China, the birthplace of Chen-style Taiji Quan. Also known as tai chi, the martial art is iconic for its slow movements and purported health benefits, but Kleber quickly discovers it’s the real deal: From being thrown around by teenagers to learning about the martial art’s Yin-Yang philosophy, Kleber experiences for himself how this kungfu style allows small to defeat big, and soft to beat strong.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.2
programme.desc: Tianran He explores Lhasa’s bustling Barkhor Street, where pilgrims, locals, and visitors alike circle its ancient lanes. This multicultural district, home to sacred temples and boutique shops, becomes the backdrop as Tianran dons traditional Tibetan attire for a photoshoot. Across the city, he meets high school students dancing for Douyin — China’s version of TikTok, blending street dance with traditional Tibetan moves. Finally, Tianran travels to the birthplace of Tibetan incense, where waterwheels still power this thousand-year-old craft.

programme.title: Foodwise: Datong
programme.desc: In this episode, Tianran He and Angela Fu are in historic Datong. Located in northern China's Shanxi Province, some 1500 years ago Datong was the capital of the Northern Wei Dynasty, which saw nomads unite northern China and Buddhism spread throughout the country. At the renowned Yungang Grottoes where giant Buddhas were carved out of cliffs, our hosts discover Datong's multicultural past and sample the emperor's favorite cake. They seek out the remains of a Jesuit church beneath the Great Wall of China, and find in the local cuisine elements that echo the past, and modern-day recipes for thousand-year old dishes.

programme.title: Foodwise: Chaozhou
programme.desc: In this episode, hosts Tianran He and Angela Fu are in Chaozhou, South China. They're on a quest to discover the secrets of its success, for Chaozhou is famed for its wealthy merchant guilds and its homegrown Teochew cuisine, which enjoys global recognition.From working as part-timers in a beef hotpot restaurant, to learning about tea ceremony and shadowing a master of Teochew cuisine, our hosts discover the best way to learn about Chaozhou, is through its food.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.4
programme.desc: Gansu, in China's northwest, is a land dominated by tremendous forces of nature: mountain ranges flanking north and south press to form the ancient Hexi Corridor, and, of course, the mighty Yellow River. Taking off in central Gansu, gliding over farmlands past and present, behold the Loess Plateau's hidden beauty as we go on a quest for an ancient city called Dunhuang...

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programme.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since.Kleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style’s fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey...

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Five Ancestors Fist
programme.desc: In Quanzhou, southeast China, Kleber seeks out masters of the Five Ancestors Fist, a combination of five local kungfu styles. He meets the abbot of a Southern Shaolin Temple, and takes part in the extraordinary training regime used by Shaolin monks to hone their bodies and minds. He experiences the intricacies of Quanzhou’s traditional puppetry, and learns how Five Ancestors Fist incorporated military tactics that allowed its practitioners to band together and fight off pirates.

programme.title: Beyond the screen: how “film ” tourism and AI redefine moviegoer experience
programme.desc: As the Beijing International Film Festival takes over the city, films are no longer just somethingwe watch in cinemas. They’re connecting tourism, retail, entertainment, and even cutting-edge tech. What does this “film plus” experience look like for audiences today? And as AI reshapes the film industry, what opportunities and challenges lie ahead?Host Xu Yawen spoke with Li Lun, assistant professor of economics at Peking University; Geng Ling, film producer and CEO of China Film Assist Company; and Teng Jimeng, associate professor of American studies at Beijing Foreign Studies University, to delve into these questions.

programme.title: What can Africa learn from China’s poverty reduction experience?
programme.desc: Five years after China eliminated absolute poverty, its development experience continues to attract attention around the world, particularly across Africa.What lessons can African countries draw from China’s journey? Can China’s poverty reduction experiences be adapted to African realities? In today’s episode, we bring scholars, journalists and development practitioners from China, The Gambia, Rwanda and Namibia.Jainaba Sonko, Zhang Yanqiu, Patrick Rurangangabo and Jeronimo Kateya explore pathways to sustainable development and poverty reduction, discussing governance, infrastructure, education, self-reliance and the future of China-Africa cooperation.

programme.title: Meet China: From Little Toys to Global Factories, How Chinese Creativity Travels
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how “Made in China” is taking on new forms. A monster toy becomes a global collectible, an ocean park in southern China turns wonder into repeat visits, and a smart EV factory in Zhejiang shows how cars are built for overseas markets. In central China’s Xuchang, a small city supplies much of the world’s hair products, while in Guangxi, an Italian chef blends pizza with traditional medicinal food. From blind boxes to electric vehicles, wigs and a yam-and-lamb pizza, this episode reveals how Chinese creativity, scale and culture are reaching the world in unexpected ways.

programme.title: BizTalk | Summer Davos special: New opportunities for growth in China
programme.desc: The 17th Annual Meeting of the New Champions, also known as Summer Davos, is underway in Dalian. During the forum, China’s technological innovation, green development and business environment have once again become key topics of discussion.In this special episode of BizTalk, CGTN speaks with Liu Zhenmin, China’s special envoy for climate change, Joe Ngai, chairman of McKinsey Greater China, and Leo Lee, president of Novartis China, to explore how China is cultivating new growth drivers amid a new wave of industrial transformation, and why “the next China is still China”.

programme.title: Biztalk Special Coverage on AI EP3
programme.desc: The Token EconomyDemand for AI tokens is surging, with trends like “tokenmaxxing” accelerating the race for computing power.As pressure mounts on computing and energy infrastructure, China is leveraging its clean energy strengths to support AI growth, while “token exports” emerge as a new way to deliver AI services to global users.What’s the future like for the “token economy”? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the economics behind the AI revolution.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays.At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward.In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future.Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.title: Meet China: From Little Toys to Global Factories, How Chinese Creativity Travels
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how “Made in China” is taking on new forms. A monster toy becomes a global collectible, an ocean park in southern China turns wonder into repeat visits, and a smart EV factory in Zhejiang shows how cars are built for overseas markets. In central China’s Xuchang, a small city supplies much of the world’s hair products, while in Guangxi, an Italian chef blends pizza with traditional medicinal food. From blind boxes to electric vehicles, wigs and a yam-and-lamb pizza, this episode reveals how Chinese creativity, scale and culture are reaching the world in unexpected ways.

programme.title: BizTalk | Summer Davos special: New opportunities for growth in China
programme.desc: The 17th Annual Meeting of the New Champions, also known as Summer Davos, is underway in Dalian. During the forum, China’s technological innovation, green development and business environment have once again become key topics of discussion.In this special episode of BizTalk, CGTN speaks with Liu Zhenmin, China’s special envoy for climate change, Joe Ngai, chairman of McKinsey Greater China, and Leo Lee, president of Novartis China, to explore how China is cultivating new growth drivers amid a new wave of industrial transformation, and why “the next China is still China”.

programme.title: Biztalk Special Coverage on AI EP3
programme.desc: The Token EconomyDemand for AI tokens is surging, with trends like “tokenmaxxing” accelerating the race for computing power.As pressure mounts on computing and energy infrastructure, China is leveraging its clean energy strengths to support AI growth, while “token exports” emerge as a new way to deliver AI services to global users.What’s the future like for the “token economy”? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the economics behind the AI revolution.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays.At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward.In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future.Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.title: Meet China: From Little Toys to Global Factories, How Chinese Creativity Travels
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how “Made in China” is taking on new forms. A monster toy becomes a global collectible, an ocean park in southern China turns wonder into repeat visits, and a smart EV factory in Zhejiang shows how cars are built for overseas markets. In central China’s Xuchang, a small city supplies much of the world’s hair products, while in Guangxi, an Italian chef blends pizza with traditional medicinal food. From blind boxes to electric vehicles, wigs and a yam-and-lamb pizza, this episode reveals how Chinese creativity, scale and culture are reaching the world in unexpected ways.

programme.title: BizTalk | Summer Davos special: New opportunities for growth in China
programme.desc: The 17th Annual Meeting of the New Champions, also known as Summer Davos, is underway in Dalian. During the forum, China’s technological innovation, green development and business environment have once again become key topics of discussion.In this special episode of BizTalk, CGTN speaks with Liu Zhenmin, China’s special envoy for climate change, Joe Ngai, chairman of McKinsey Greater China, and Leo Lee, president of Novartis China, to explore how China is cultivating new growth drivers amid a new wave of industrial transformation, and why “the next China is still China”.

programme.title: Biztalk Special Coverage on AI EP3
programme.desc: The Token EconomyDemand for AI tokens is surging, with trends like “tokenmaxxing” accelerating the race for computing power.As pressure mounts on computing and energy infrastructure, China is leveraging its clean energy strengths to support AI growth, while “token exports” emerge as a new way to deliver AI services to global users.What’s the future like for the “token economy”? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the economics behind the AI revolution.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays.At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward.In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future.Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.title: Meet China: From Little Toys to Global Factories, How Chinese Creativity Travels
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we explore how “Made in China” is taking on new forms. A monster toy becomes a global collectible, an ocean park in southern China turns wonder into repeat visits, and a smart EV factory in Zhejiang shows how cars are built for overseas markets. In central China’s Xuchang, a small city supplies much of the world’s hair products, while in Guangxi, an Italian chef blends pizza with traditional medicinal food. From blind boxes to electric vehicles, wigs and a yam-and-lamb pizza, this episode reveals how Chinese creativity, scale and culture are reaching the world in unexpected ways.

programme.desc: The Token EconomyDemand for AI tokens is surging, with trends like “tokenmaxxing” accelerating the race for computing power.As pressure mounts on computing and energy infrastructure, China is leveraging its clean energy strengths to support AI growth, while “token exports” emerge as a new way to deliver AI services to global users.What’s the future like for the “token economy”? Join us on BizTalk as we explore the economics behind the AI revolution.

programme.title: China's rural CEO experiment: How a Dai village is reinventing itself
programme.desc: During the Dai New Year, CGTN reporter Lincoln Humphries visited Manluanzhan, a traditional Dai village near China's southwestern border in Yunnan Province. There, "sleeping" assets are being awakened: an abandoned water tower has been turned into a café, and traditional Dai houses have been expanded to offer new types of homestays.At the center of this experiment is an unusual figure — a rural CEO who helps balance economic development with the Dai community's traditions as the village charts its own path forward.In this episode of #BizFocus, Lincoln Humphries shows how a village in Xishuangbanna brings fresh vitality and authentic traditions together.

programme.title: The new keeper of the ancient village in the deep mountains
programme.desc: Deep in the mountains of Fujian, Yanxiang village is home to centuries-old Hakka architecture and an aging population. But a post 1995-born returnee is giving the ancient village a new future.Follow CGTN’s He Jingyi to see how a young village chief blends modern ideas with traditional heritage, breathing new life into this millennium-old rural settlement. #BizFocus

programme.title: How rafting helped one village find new life
programme.desc: In Sankengtan Village, Guangdong Province, a river that once flowed quietly through everyday life is now part of the Gulong Gorge rafting course—a global destination drawing millions of visitors each year. What was once a quiet rural community has been transformed by tourism, as local residents build new livelihoods around the river and the opportunities it brings. In this episode of BizFocus, CGTN's Vivienne Nunis joins those braving the white water to find out more.

programme.desc: Drie vrienden met een handicap (Yannick van de Velde, Martijn Lakemeier en Bas Hoeflaak) willen net als iedere andere jonge twintiger wel eens met iemand naar bed. Eén van hen weet dat de meisjes in Salou altijd gewillig zijn, dus dan moeten ze daar maar heen.

programme.desc: Een jonge vrouw twijfelt aan al haar keuzes in het verleden en besluit dat ze haar ex-vriend moet terugwinnen. Maar hij heeft nu een verloofde.

programme.desc: In een ouderwets casino in Las Vegas wordt de vloek van de grootste gokgek verbroken als hij verliefd wordt, tot grote ontsteltenis van zijn baas.

programme.title: A Taste of Love
programme.desc: Een worstelende tv-chef keert naar huis terug en ontdekt dat het restaurant van haar familie te koop staat, niet in staat om te concurreren met de hedendaagse keuken. In een poging het te redden, hernieuwt ze het contact met haar jeugdliefde en vindt ze de inspiratie die ze zocht.

programme.title: 5 to 7
programme.desc: 5 to 7 is een meeslepend romantisch drama dat verwijst naar de tijd die men in het klassieke Parijs had voor de minnaar of minnares. Brian ontmoet de mooie getrouwde Arielle, wordt halsoverkop verliefd en begint een liefdevolle affaire.

programme.title: Weg Van Jou

programme.title: A Few Best Men
programme.desc: In deze hilarische komedie sluit de Britse David zijn jaartje backpacken wel heel origineel af. Vlak voor zijn terugreis vraagt hij zijn Australische travel mate Mia ten huwelijk en ze zegt ja!

programme.title: Sharing Relations
programme.desc: Scott heeft weinig gemaakt van zijn leven. Hij gebruikt drugs, heeft geen baan en is volledig vervreemd van zijn familie. Uiteindelijk besluit hij het contact met zijn broer William en zijn zieke vader te herstellen. Eén probleem: William is inmiddels getrouwd met Scotts ex-vriendin Katherine.

programme.desc: Hyde Park on Hudson laat een historische gebeurtenis zien die de menselijke kant onderstreept van een van de meest iconische leiders uit de Amerikaanse geschiedenis, Franklin Roosevelt.

programme.title: Dinner with Friends
programme.desc: Abby kijkt uit naar een ontspannen Thanksgiving met haar beste vriendin Molly. Maar hun plan voor een rustig diner gaat in rook op als Molly’s nieuwe vriendje en haar flamboyante moeder ook ineens aanschuiven.

programme.title: Liever Verliefd
programme.desc: Als haar laatste liefje Dirk met haar breekt om zijn huwelijk een nieuwe kans te geven, heeft Anna het helemaal gehad. Voor haar geen mannen meer. Nooit. Nog diezelfde dag ontmoet ze Rob.

programme.title: Most Likely to Murder
programme.desc: Een coming-of-age-verhaal, 10 jaar te laat, over een doorsnee man die in een mysterie wordt gegooid ver boven zijn kunnen, moed of intelligentie, en druipt van het bloed en waterpijp berust.

programme.title: An Nelissen: Zus
programme.desc: ‘Zus’ is de achtste soloshow van An Nelissen, de topcomedienne die van elke voorstelling een avontuur maakt. Het gaat over familiegeheimen, porno, seksuele voorlichting in de sixties, opgroeien met broers, hoe organiseer je best een vrijgezellenfeestje en nog veel meer. An vertelt altijd heel persoonlijke en taboedoorbrekende verhalen, maar in deze show ging ze toch nog een stapje verder.

programme.title: Rayen Panday: Niet Verder Vertellen
programme.desc: Cabaretier Rayen Panday staat bekend om zijn scherpe grappen, muzikale talent en zelfspot. Na zijn vele optredens in binnen- en buitenland en het succes van de cabaretvoorstellingen Drie Keer Rayen en Vrijspraak, stond Rayen vorig jaar met Niet Verder Vertellen in de Nederlandse theaters.

programme.title: Jasper van Kuijk: Janus
programme.desc: In Janus bekijkt Jasper van Kuijk de zaken rigoureus van twee kanten. Want in onze gepolariseerde wereld lijkt het wel steeds óf-óf, maar het is natuurlijk net zo vaak én-én. Daarom laat Van Kuijk zijn compromisloze nuance los op de actualiteit. Cabaret om bij naar voren te leunen, dat én ergens over gaat én vermaakt.

programme.title: Joost Vandecasteele: In Onaanvaardbare Staat
programme.desc: In “onaanvaardbare staat” staat Vandecasteele er een comedyshow waar zowel comedy als show in vraag worden gesteld. Iets anders dus. Iets tussen het politieke en het persoonlijke, het perverse en het poreuze. programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On April 18th 2014, in Visé, Belgium, policemen are informed that gunshots had been fired on the street.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On March 21th 1991, Pascale Escarfail, 19 years old, is discovered dead at her studio in the 14th arrondissement of Paris, she was raped then stabbed multiple times.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Did Françoise Desnoue run away? Or did she reattempt to kill herself? Clues will help investigators to see in between the subterfuges and lies, leading them to the terrible truth.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the morning of July 24th 2009, a fire erupts at house in Plougonvelin. Inside the house, firefighters find the burned body of Jean-Jacques Le Page.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the morning of January 9th 2014, Josiane Bézard, 53 years old, drives her son to the Manosque's train station, and then vanishes.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On December 9th 1987, the naked body of the young Evelyne Boucher is found near Avignon. An unprecedented investigation begins making headlines.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On May 30th 2015 in Sorinières, Yann Machand reports his wife Céline Marchand missing. Despite a call for evidence and numerous researches, this 39 years old heir, mother of two is nowhere to be found.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Around 11PM the police are called for an assault in a parking lot in the forest of Saint-Lambet-des-Bois.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On January 27th 2014, in Somme-Suippe in the Marne, Sophie Thevenet discovers her husband dead in the garage.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 11th 2011, in Èze, near Monaco, the owner of a luxury villa discovers the lifeless hanging body of his tenant, a rich German businessman.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On June 12th 2007, in Berhen-lès-Forbach, in Moselle, a young woman reports the disappearance of her brother Raphaël Lomoro, a 46 years old vanilla producer living in Madagascar.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On November 9th 2007, around 11:30PM, aid arrives on the scene of an accident at the exit of Chateney-en-France.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 12, 2013, Eric Mosser, a 45-year-old heating engineer, discovers his wife Isabelle lying in a pool of blood at their home in Illfurth, Alsace.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 5, 2000, two hunters discover a charred body on the banks of the Oise.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 8, 2002, near Amiens, a farmer discovers the lifeless body of a young woman, Patricia Leclercq, on his field.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On June 30, 2014, in Nancy, the police are called to the home of Julie Martin, a 34-year-old nurse.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On November 9, 2011, the body of a man was found near the Courcelles-le-Comte cemetery (Pas-de-Calais).

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On September 7, 2018, in Strasbourg, Sophie Le Tan is about to celebrate her 20th birthday with her family.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On the night of April 16, 2013, Anaïs Guillaume, 21, mysteriously disappears in Fromy (Ardennes) after spending the evening at her companion's farm.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A damaged bike belonging to 16-year-old Karine Schaaff is found abandoned on the side of a road in Moselle; 10 days later her body is found just kilometers away, hidden in a forest.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Xavier Flactif, his partner Graziella and their three children suddenly disappear; there are many theories surrounding this mysterious case.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The lifeless, mutilated body of a woman is found in the Rambouillet Forest; the police are perplexed by the clues found at the crime scene and the state of the body which is missing both the head and heart.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year-old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a car accident while on his honeymoon; Marc's wife, Aurore, isn't injured in the accident and the case is quickly dismissed; Marc's family is suspicious of Aurore.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 52-year-old Marina Ciampi is found dead at her home in Marseille; she is found naked on her bed with a plastic bag over her head, but there is no trace of a break-in; police investigate several unknown DNA traces.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On 1 December 2005, Dominique Aubry, a wealthy widow, is found hanged in her houseboat in Neuilly; the case is quickly classified as a suicide, but this argument is problematic.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Firefighters in Barbizieux, Charente are called to a fire at a large house in the village; they arrive to find the lifeless body of the owner, 83-year-old Claude Tavernier, lying in a large pool of blood.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: 18-year-old Laetitia Perrais is a trainee hotel waitress who vanishes after an evening shift; every attempt is made to shed light on her disappearance and the efforts eventually pay off.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case): On the night of July 16, 2000, the life of Edwige Alessandri changed forever. This mother, married to a supermarket boss, made a frantic emergency call in the town of Carpentras. She recounted that shortly after midnight, some men burst into her room and shot her husband while he slept. Who could have despised Richard Alessandri enough to kill him in cold blood in his own bed? Was he the victim of a robbery gone wrong, as claimed by his wife?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Dire Deception (LAURENCE MAILLE CASE): On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned. An unprecedented search was immediately launched to try to find her. Beautiful, intelligent and generous, Laurence Maille had everything to be happy about and for 18 months, had found the perfect love in her partner.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Mystery of Room 602 (Véronique Pirotton Case): On October 31, 2013, Belgian politician Bernard Ouessfal rushed down the six flights of a hotel in Ostend where he had met up with his wife, Véronique, the day before. He had just found her unconscious on the bathroom floor with a mysterious plastic bag next to her. Despite the emergency rescue response, Véronique Pirotton died a few minutes later.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case) - On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up. In this astonishing case, the clues examined by the experts will give them two leads: two men, two suspects with very different profiles... but investigators are convinced that they both have a direct link with the murder.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: THE CASE OF STÉPHANE KAMEUGNE - On December 24, 2008, the body of Stéphane Kameugne was fished out from a canal in Châlons-en-Champagne. The young man had been missing for two weeks and no one had seen him since the evening of his graduation ceremony from his engineering school. A theory soon emerged: the very drunk student had fallen over thea bridge over the canal which led to his death. But his parents and relatives did not believe this.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: The Savage Murder of a Mother and her Daughter (Amato Case)- On March 31, 2003, firefighters were called to a fire in a housing estate of Meyrargues, near Aix-en-Provence. On site, they discovered a horrific scene: the tortured and charred bodies of a mother and her daughter, Chantal and Audrey D'Amato, aged 53 and 24 respectively.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Night of Horror at Devil's Plateau (Marie-Jeanne Meyer Case) - On June 18, 2011, Marie-Jeanne Meyer, 17-years old, waved goodbye to her little sister before leaving for her daily jog on the heights of Tournon in Ardèche. She never came back. Three days later, her mutilated body was found in a freshly dug pit, near an area known to be cursed, "The Devil's Plateau." What's more, the crime scene looked like a mystical ritual ... Was it a ritual murder? Revenge? An unfortunate encounter? ...

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: A Mysterious Murder at the Farm (Valérie Bary Case)- On Friday, March 26, 2004, in the region of Dijon, Laurent Bary came home from his work to discover the lifeless body of his wife, Valerie, bathing in a pool of blood. According to the investigators' initial findings, the 38-year-old nurse's aid had been stabbed several times, seeming to validate the theory of a robbery gone wrong.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: On July 13, 2011, two boaters retrieved a suitcase that was floating in the bay of Lorient. Inside, they discovered the tied up corpse of a man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers
programme.desc: Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake (CASE OF RUTH LÉGERET) - On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows? Clue after clue, the Swiss police's investigation would revolve around an environment of family jealousy and financial greed.

programme.title: The History of Home Narrated by Nick Offerman
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Foundations of Home - Structure and Shelter
programme.desc: The History of Home is a story that is ever-changing, constantly being renovated and built upon. As homes changed, so too did our lives.

programme.title: The History of Home Narrated by Nick Offerman
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 The Hall, The Kitchen, The Dining Room, The Living Room
programme.desc: Now that we've reviewed the fundamentals of shelter - the past, present, and future of materials - it's time to step over the threshold and find out who is home.

programme.title: The History of Home Narrated by Nick Offerman
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 The Second Story - Private Life
programme.desc: In the final episode, The History of Home will focus on private life by exploring the history of three rooms; The study, the bedroom, and the bathroom.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The Rich & The Royal
programme.desc: From the Rhode Island coastline to the Forests of France, what unites the rich and the royal is a love of a grand home.

programme.title: The History of Home Presents... History's Greatest Homes
programme.desc: In this episode, we get an up-close and personal look as we pull back the curtain on the fascinating history behind one of America’s most iconic homes, Hearst Castle.

programme.title: The History of Home Presents... History's Greatest Homes

programme.title: Everyone Wants To Be The Next Weismann
programme.desc: Nadat hij in de schaduw van zijn oude ontdekking heeft geleefd, probeert een kunstverzamelaar de volgende grote kunstenaar te vinden, een Taiwanese schilder uit Brookling. Zullen de vervolgen net zo goed of beter zijn dan het origineel?

programme.title: Nourathar
programme.desc: Door de creaties van verschillende hedendaagse kunstenaars repeteert de film een inspirerende verkenning van de relatie tussen natuur, kunst en technologie.

programme.title: Barcelona: Surf Destination
programme.desc: Voor het eerst in de geschiedenis wordt surfen in Tokyo 2020 als Olympische sport beschouwd en heeft het zijn eerste kampioen: Ítalo Ferreira. De gouden medaillewinnaar verlaat de stranden van Brazilië om naar Barcelona te reizen, waar hij de lokale surfscene ziet en hoe de mensen er zijn.

programme.title: Les Saisons
programme.desc: Nadat ze op vleugels rond de wereld vlogen en met walvissen en manta's over oceanen surften, keren natuurfilmgrootmeesters Jacques Perrin en Jacques Cluzaud terug naar bekender terrein. Ze nemen ons mee op een prachtige reis door de geschiedenis van de Europese wildernis.

programme.title: 1: Life On The Limit
programme.desc: Lewis Hamilton, Jenson Button, Alain Prost, Sebastian Vettel, Michael Schumacher, Niki Lauda, Sid Watkins, Sir Jackie Stewart, Jacky Ickx, Emerson Fittipaldi, Bernie Ecclestone... zomaar wat namen die voorbij komen in deze weergaloze documentaire over de wereld van de Formule 1.

programme.title: De geheimen van La Roja - Wereldkampioenen 2010
programme.desc: Op 11 juli 2010 won het Spaanse nationale elftal de Wereldbeker, een overwinning voor het team én het hele land. Maar vóór dit legendarische succes moest “La Roja” wel eerst heel wat moeilijkheden overwinnen.

programme.title: Transvulcania, de race van het volk
programme.desc: Transvulcania is één van de meest iconische trailrunningevenementen ter wereld. Het is een race die de locals echt als eigen voelen. Deze documentaire verdiept zich in de persoonlijke verhalen van de atleten en de bewoners van het eiland, die jaren van tegenspoed hebben meegemaakt.

programme.title: Ride your Dream
programme.desc: De motorsport was een typische mannenwereld, tot nu. In deze documentaire maken we kennis met Ana Carrasco, de Spaanse motorrijder die de wereld van de motorraces heeft gerevolutioneerd en die sinds haar prilste jeugd maar één droom had: wereldkampioen worden.

programme.title: HairStyle, The Talent Show USA: Afleveringen 5-6
programme.desc: Afleveringen: 5-6. Niet elke klant is moeilijk te plezieren, maar de klanten moeten de salon tevreden verlaten. In de 2e uitdaging gaan de deelnemers aan de slag met de haarkleur, waarbij ze veel aandacht aan de verzorging besteden.

programme.title: Andrés Iniesta, De Onverwachte Held
programme.desc: Dit is het verhaal van een normale persoon die uitzonderlijke dingen doet. Iemand die successen nastreeft én boekt door op de details te letten, want het zijn die details die van hem een unieke voetbalspeler maken. We kennen allemaal de tovenaar die Iniesta is met de bal...

programme.title: Kampioenen
programme.desc: Julia Simic, Bundesliga winnares en AC Milan speelster, reist van Nürenberg om Dafina Redzepi (TSG Hoffenheim) op te halen en op bezoek te gaan bij Bärbel Wohlleben, die de eer heeft de eerste vrouw te zijn wiens doelpunt door ARD Sportschau werd uitgeroepen tot Doelpunt van de maand.

programme.title: HairStyle The Talent Show USA: Afleveringen 1-2
programme.desc: Afleveringen: 1-2. In de eerste aflevering stellen de deelnemers zich aan de jury voor, vertrouwend op hun vindingrijkheid om een freestyle look te creëren. TV persoonlijkheid en mode influencer Tina Leung zal de salon bezoeken om commentaar te geven op de haarverzorgingsroutines.

programme.title: HairStyle, The Talent Show USA: Afleveringen 3-4
programme.desc: Afleveringen: 3-4. De 1e uitdaging is stylen in de meest kritische omgeving te stylen: bruiloft. Daarna gaan de deelnemers het beschadigde haar van de klanten van de salon herstellen.

programme.title: Everyone Wants To Be The Next Weismann
programme.desc: Nadat hij in de schaduw van zijn oude ontdekking heeft geleefd, probeert een kunstverzamelaar de volgende grote kunstenaar te vinden, een Taiwanese schilder uit Brookling. Zullen de vervolgen net zo goed of beter zijn dan het origineel?

programme.title: Opkomst van de superhelden
programme.desc: Dit is het verhaal van hoe superhelden uit stripboeken tot leven kwamen in de bioscoop, van Tim Burtons Batman-films tot The Avengers, Black Panther en meer, en hoe ze eerst Hollywood overnamen en vervolgens de wereld veroverden.

programme.title: Daughters of the Sexual Revolution: The Untold Story of the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders
programme.desc: Deze onverschrokken film, gemaakt door de voor een Academy Award genomineerde regisseur Dana Adam Shapiro, vertelt het verhaal van de opkomst van de Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders als een metafoor voor de Amerikaanse seksuele revolutie op haar hoogtepunt.

programme.title: Drag Becomes Him
programme.desc: Via een intiem bezoek aan de kleedkamer van Jinkx Moonson ontdekken we hoe deze jongen uit een arbeidersmilieu erin is geslaagd een internationaal gevierde travestieperformer te worden.

programme.title: The Shore Break
programme.desc: Twee neven uit een hechte plattelandsgemeenschap hebben tegengestelde plannen om hun vaderland aan de wilde kust van Zuid-Afrika te ontwikkelen.

programme.title: Fast Forward
programme.desc: Fast Forward is een documentaireserie van vijf afleveringen die in de toekomst kijkt door middel van opkomende technologieën die zijn gericht op het aanpakken van enkele van de meest vitale uitdagingen waarmee de wereld vandaag wordt geconfronteerd.

programme.title: Discovering Canary Islands: Afleveringen 5-6
programme.desc: Afleveringen: La Palma - El Hierro en La Gomera. Slechts twee gelukkigen kunnen door naar de grote finale. Hiervoor moeten ze hun vaardigheden in de Guanche-taal, die door de oude bewoners van de eilanden gesproken werd, meten.

programme.title: Justin Bieber's Believe
programme.desc: Na de wereldwijde hit Never Say Never is Justin Bieber dit jaar terug met een gloednieuwe film. Met hoogtepunten van zijn waanzinnige BELIEVE concerttour, maar vooral met veel beeld uit zijn jeugd. Zie hoe hij van een muzikaal jochie uit Canada het grootste idool alive werd.

programme.title: Kampioenen
programme.desc: Wendie Renard, zevenvoudig UEFA kampioene en FIFA's vrouwelijke speelster in 2018, wacht op de komst van Annie Fortems, een pionierster van het Franse vrouwenvoetbal en Sonia Ouchene, een veelbelovende jonge speelster uit Stade de Reims, in het Olympique Lyonnais-stadion.

programme.title: Make Up Stars: Afleveringen 5-6
programme.desc: Afleveringen: Natuur - En de winnaar is... In de halve finale staan de deelnemers voor een bodypainting-uitdaging waarin ze een van de vier natuurelementen moeten uitbeelden, onder deskundige begeleiding van Corinne Pérez.

In 2022 komen beide passies in botsing en zo ontdekken we het een en ander over de man en zijn verleden...

programme.title: Break Point: A Davis Cup Story
programme.desc: Voor het eerst zou het wereldkampioenschap tennis maar een week duren en in een stad gehouden worden: Madrid. Achttien teams streefden ernaar om de gewaardeerde "saladeschaal"-trofee te winnen. Onder leiding van Rafa Nadal was het Spaanse team dit jaar favoriet totdat ze een serieuze setback kregen.

programme.title: Bojan, achter de glimlach
programme.desc: Bojan Krkic had het succes in de palm van zijn hand, maar de moeilijkheden waarmee hij als vroegrijp talent te maken kreeg, hebben zijn carrière gemarkeerd sinds hij als 16-jarige bij FC Barcelona debuteerde. Hij is een duidelijk voorbeeld van de druk die jonge talenten in de sport ondervinden.

programme.title: Thick as Thieves

programme.desc: Karen en Michel, begin dertigers, verhuizen met hun dochtertje naar een exclusieve villawijk. Al snel vindt Karen een hechte vriendenkring in de vrouwen van De Eetclub en hun echtgenoten.

programme.title: The Big Short
programme.desc: Gebaseerd op het ware verhaal van vier buitenstaanders die zagen wat de grote banken, media en regering negeerden: het wereldwijde inzakken van de economie. Een gewaagde investering brengt hen in de donkere onderbuik van het bankwezen, waar ze niets of niemand kunnen vertrouwen.

programme.title: Till
programme.desc: "Till" is een emotionele bioscoopfilm over het waargebeurde verhaal van Mamie Till-Mobley's niet aflatende streven naar gerechtigheid voor haar 14-jarige zoon, Emmett Till, die in 1955 werd gelyncht tijdens een bezoek aan zijn neven in Mississippi.

programme.title: Warning Shot
programme.desc: Audrey, een alleenstaande moeder van dochter Cheyenne, heeft moeite om de eindjes aan elkaar te knopen. Wanneer haar grootvader overlijdt, erft ze de familieboerderij inclusief waterrechten.

programme.title: Extraction
programme.desc: Leonard Turner is een voormalige CIA-agent die niet meer zichzelf is sinds zijn vrouw is vermoord. Zijn zoon Harry is een frisse, jonge CIA-medewerker die in de voetsporen van zijn vader treedt. Samen werken ze aan de ontwikkeling van een superwapen genaamd de Condor.

programme.title: Raging Bull
programme.desc: Robert De Niro won een Oscar voor beste acteur in dit veelgeprezen meesterwerk als Jake LaMotta, de controversiële prijsvechter uit de jaren 1940 wiens wreedheid verder reikte dan de ring. Cathy Moriarty en Joe Pesci co-ster.

programme.title: Het programmeren wordt binnenkort hervat.
programme.desc: We halen ons schoonheidsslaapje in! Blijf op de hoogte voor nog meer onschatbaar entertainment, samengesteld door Rakuten TV.

programme.title: The Mercy
programme.desc: Op zoek naar erkenning en geld om zijn noodlijdende bedrijf te redden, besluit de Engelse amateurzeiler Donald Crowhurst (Colin Firth) om mee te doen aan de Golden Globe Race, een non-stop solo zeilrace om de wereld.

programme.title: People You May Know
programme.desc: Jed, een introvert van in de dertig, heeft het tot nu toe volgehouden om zich van sociale media te onthouden. Wanneer hij de gigantische taak krijgt om te definiëren wie hij is, beseft hij dat het leven dat hij kan veinzen veel interessanter is dan het leven dat hij daadwerkelijk leidt.

programme.title: Oorlogsgeheimen
programme.desc: Zomer 1943. Tuur (Maas Bronkhuyzen) en Lambert (Joes Brauers) zijn al van jongs af aan onafscheidelijk. De omgeving van hun Zuid-Limburgse dorp kent geen geheimen voor de vrienden.

programme.title: De Eetclub
programme.desc: Karen en Michel, begin dertigers, verhuizen met hun dochtertje naar een exclusieve villawijk. Al snel vindt Karen een hechte vriendenkring in de vrouwen van De Eetclub en hun echtgenoten.

programme.title: Rookie
programme.desc: ROOKIE volgt het verhaal van Nicky, een jonge ambitieuze en zelfverzekerde motorrijder pur sang. Elke race zet hij zijn leven op het spel, niet voor geld maar voor de kicks, het respect en de roem. Zijn wereld stort onverwachts in wanneer hij door een ongeval nooit meer zal kunnen racen...

programme.title: Oorlogswinter
programme.desc: Oorlogswinter is het verhaal van Michiel die in de laatste ijskoude winter van de oorlog volwassen wordt. Zijn Oom Ben, die in het verzet zit, is zijn grote voorbeeld en Michiel kan niet wachten tot hij ook wat kan betekenen in de strijd tegen de bezetter.

programme.title: Arthur & Mike
programme.desc: Wallace Avery haat zijn leven. Zijn baan is doodsaai, zijn ex-vrouw en kinderen ziet hij nauwelijks en zijn nieuwe vriendin irriteert hem. Hij besluit helemaal opnieuw te beginnen.

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Books is een gepensioneerde revolverheld die stervende is aan kanker en hij bevindt zich in een stad vol mensen die graag naam willen maken door de revolverheld te zijn die hem vermoordt.

programme.title: Argentina, 1985
programme.desc: Deze film volgt het David-versus-Goliathverhaal om de bloedigste militaire dictatuur van Argentinië te vervolgen en de slachtoffers recht te geven.

programme.title: Goodbye Lover
programme.desc: In het zonovergoten Los Angeles aast de slimme, sexy en onscrupuleuze Sandra Dunmore op een groter stuk van de taart van het goede leven. Tijdens haar weg naar de top moet Sandra misschien op wat teentjes trappen – in haar stiletto’s. Maar daar heeft ze geen probleem mee.

programme.title: The Flowers of War
programme.desc: Flowers of War is gesitueerd in 1937 in Nanjing in China tijdens de Sino-Japanse oorlog. Een stel dappere vluchtingen wordt opgevangen in een kerk. De groep, samengekomen door de verschrikkelijke chaos van de oorlog...

programme.title: Warning Shot

programme.title: Thick as Thieves
programme.desc: Twee meesterdieven raken in conflict wanneer de één de ander erin luist. Alec Baldwin speelt de charmante professional, Michael Jai White de gangster. Hun strijd trekt een maffiabaas en een agente mee in een explosieve confrontatie.

programme.title: The Age Of Adaline
programme.desc: Wat als je voor altijd jong en mooi blijft? Het overkomt de jonge moeder Adaline (Blake Lively) na een mysterieus auto-ongeluk in de jaren '30. Terwijl de wereld om haar heen doorgaat en haar dochter (Ellen Burstyn) bejaard wordt, wordt Adaline zelf geen dag ouder.

programme.title: Argentina, 1985

programme.title: Women talking
programme.desc: "Women talking" volgt een groep vrouwen in een geïsoleerde religieuze kolonie terwijl ze bedenken wat ze moeten doen om een betere wereld voor zichzelf en hun kinderen te bouwen. Vertrekken, of blijven en vechten. Niets doen is geen optie.

programme.desc: In Ophelia wordt het beroemde verhaal van Shakespeare’s Hamlet herverteld vanuit de ogen van zijn geliefde Ophelia. Ophelia (Daisy Ridley) is de meest vertrouwde hofdame van Koningin Gertrude (Naomi Watts)...
