programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 31, 32, 33
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: Comin' at Ya!
programme.desc: De broers Pike en Polk vallen een bruiloft aan, schieten de bruidegom neer en ontvoeren vrouwen om ze te verkopen. H. H. Hart overleeft en jaagt de broers op. Hij bevrijdt de vrouwen, maar wordt gevangen genomen, enkel overlevend dankzij zijn gevangene Polk.

programme.title: Alive or Preferably Dead
programme.desc: Twee broers, Monty en Ted, erven 300.000 dollar als ze zes maanden samenwonen.

programme.title: Dead are Countless
programme.desc: Als kind zag Johnny hoe soldaten zijn vader doodden. Getekend door wrok groeit hij uit tot een meedogenloze outlaw die elke soldaat neerhaalt die hij tegenkomt. Het leger stuurt luitenant Garringo eropuit om Johnny levend te arresteren, maar de jacht verandert al snel in een gevaarlijk spel van wraak en recht.

programme.title: For a Book of Dollars
programme.desc: Een premiejager genaamd Amen wordt ingehuurd door een groep nonnen om gestolen geld terug te halen. De nonnen zijn eigenlijk vrouwelijke desperado’s in vermomming die de buit willen terugvinden, geroofd door de outlaw Catapult en zijn bende.

programme.title: Return of Sabata
programme.desc: De inwoners van Hobsonville huren een revolverheld in om zich te ontdoen van de McIntock-clan, die onder het mom van stadsontwikkeling gewelddadig en onrechtmatig belasting heft op de inwoners.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Shalee Jethro (Dorothy Malone) helpt haar vader met het runnen van een postkoetsstation in de woestijn.

programme.title: Bury Them Deep
programme.desc: Billy Gun berooft de legeruitbetaling. Het leger huurt Clive Norton in om het geld terug te halen. Norton redt een man van de galg die een hekel heeft aan Billy Gun: El Chaleco, Billy’s broer. Samen jagen ze op de beruchte outlaw.

programme.title: Stagecoach (1939)
programme.desc: Een groep mensen die met een postkoets reist, wordt bemoeilijkt door de dreiging van Geronimo en leert daarbij iets over elkaar.

programme.title: Deadly Trackers
programme.desc: Jeff wil elk van de vijf bandieten vermoorden die zijn arme zus hebben beroofd, verkracht en vermoord.

programme.title: Custer of the West
programme.desc: George Armstrong Custer's liefde voor de heroïsche tradities van de Calvarie en zijn afkeer van de komst van de industrialisatie leidt hem naar zijn lot bij de Little Big Horn.

programme.title: Degueyo
programme.desc: Ramons bende valt Danger City aan op zoek naar een schat. Ze doden of gijzelen de mannen en dreigen vrouwen en kinderen met de meedogenloze “Deguello”. Vier mannen, zelf op jacht naar Ramon, besluiten de stad te helpen in haar wanhopige verdediging.

programme.title: My Name Is Shanghai Joe
programme.desc: Een Chinese immigrant, net aangekomen in Amerika, vecht om Mexicaanse slaven te bevrijden van hun wrede meester.

programme.title: Black Jack
programme.desc: Na een bankroof in het Wilde Westen verzamelt een bende zich rond leider Jack Murphy. Wanneer Skinner, Reb, Mathias en de broers Bill en Gordon ontdekken dat Jack de buit voor zichzelf wil houden, slaan ze de handen ineen om hem te verraden en nemen al snel actie.

programme.title: Brother Outlaw
programme.desc: Een man wordt valselijk beschuldigd van een bankoverval, waardoor zijn broer hem uit de gevangenis wil breken.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: De Mexicaanse boer Joaquin Murieta reist met zijn vrouw naar Californië op zoek naar goud, maar verliest alles aan wreedheid en racisme. Verteerd door verdriet vormt hij een bende om wraak te nemen, tot zijn eigen mannen hem verraden. Zijn lot bezegelt zich in een laatste, tragische confrontatie met de sheriff die hem ooit als vriend kende.

programme.title: Dead Men Don't Make Shadows
programme.desc: Lazar, een gevreesde premiejager die bounties liever doodt dan levend vangt, chanteert Barrett, een voormalige bandiet die met harde hand een goudmijnstadje bestuurt. Een jonge scherpschutter volgt Lazar en samen werken ze samen, maar niet iedereen jaagt alleen op goud.

programme.title: Twice a Judas
programme.desc: Luke Barrett ontwaakt in de woestijn met geheugenverlies en een geweer met 'Dingus'. In de saloon ontmoet hij een mysterieuze vreemdeling die zijn naam kent. Langzaam ontdekt Luke dat hij met zijn partner is ingehuurd om zijn broer Victor te doden. Terwijl herinneringen terugkomen, wachten hem grote keuzes.

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Westernlegendes Pat Garrett, Doc Holliday en Billy the Kid worden tegen elkaar uitgespeeld over de wet en de attenties van het pittige plattelandsmeisje Rio McDonald.

programme.title: Apache Rifles
programme.desc: Arizona, 1879: Kapitein Stanton moet de Apaches terugbrengen naar hun reservaat. Hij sluit een fragiel akkoord met hun leider, maar hebzuchtige kolonisten saboteren de vrede. Met moord en manipulatie drijven ze Stanton en de Apaches in het nauw. Wanneer een nieuwe commandant hard ingrijpt, blijkt de uitkomst fataal.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, een eenvoudige boerenknecht, moet hulp krijgen van een groep wilde buitenbeentjes en een schat vinden voordat de bandiet die hij imiteert hem vindt.

programme.title: Shotgun
programme.desc: Deputy Marshal Clay Hardin gaat achter de bende van Ben Thompson aan na de moord op Marshal Fletcher. Thompson, die Fletcher met een shotgun doodde, is nu het doelwit van Hardin. Terwijl hij de bende volgt, komt Hardin onderweg een premiejager en een mooie halfbloed vrouw tegen. Ze reizen samen richting Apachegebied, waar de bende wapens wil verkopen aan de indianen.

programme.title: Kill the Wicked
programme.desc: Barmhartige Samaritaan Benny Hudson en een gestrande vrouw Jenny worden gemarteld als ze per ongeluk een schuilplaats van een bende in een spookstad binnenlopen.

programme.title: Death on High Mountain
programme.desc: Wanneer een overval mislukt, raken twee jonge mannen verstrikt in de nasleep. Ze komen lijnrecht tegenover een bende Mexicaanse bandieten en een corrupte zakenman te staan, die koste wat kost de buit terug willen. Wat begint als toeval verandert al snel in een strijd om overleving en gerechtigheid.

programme.title: Four Fast Guns
programme.desc: In 1873 arriveert een schutter in Purgatory en doet zich voor als de gehuurde vredestichter. Hij neemt het op tegen een meedogenloze salooneigenaar, die drie huurmoordenaars inzet om hem uit de weg te ruimen. Met een beloning op zijn hoofd en een schuld te vereffenen, moet hij sneller zijn dan zijn vijanden.

programme.title: War of the Wildcats
programme.desc: In 1906, op het land van de Indianen van Oklahoma, vecht een cowboy voor oliepachtrechten tegen een hebzuchtige olieman terwijl een mooie lerares de harten van beide mannen steelt.

programme.title: Colt in the Hand of the Devil
programme.desc: Bendeleider El Condor valt zoveel goudkaravanen aan dat de woestijn bij Las Vegas ‘Valley of Death’ wordt genoemd. Het leger zet een hoge beloning uit en lokt de gevangene Pat Scotty uit de cel om El Condor te stoppen.

programme.title: No Killing Without Dollars
programme.desc: Lawrence White keert terug naar Owell Rock om de moord op zijn vader te wreken. Om zijn plannen te kunnen uitvoeren, verandert hij zijn naam en laat hij een andere man zich voordoen als "Lawrence White."

programme.title: Boot Hill
programme.desc: Slachtoffers van de onderdrukkende stadsbaas Honey krijgen hulp aangeboden door een ongewone alliantie van schutters en circusartiesten.

programme.title: Outlaw Women
programme.desc: In deze unieke 50's western wordt een stad beheerd door vrouwen, waar mannen niet welkom zijn. Een vrouwelijke outlaw, onder de indruk van de medische vaardigheden van een jonge arts, dwingt hem naar de stad te reizen, die wordt gedomineerd door een corrupte gokhal. De stad komt in gevaar door een bende outlaws en de verkiezing van een nieuwe marshal, waar de vrouwen niet aan mee mogen doen.

programme.title: And Now... Make Your Peace with God
programme.desc: Twee mannen reizen naar Denver City om persoonlijke rekeningen te vereffenen: de een zoekt de moordenaar van zijn vader, de ander een vriend die zijn goud stal. Ze worden vergezeld door een mysterieuze scherpschutter. Samen begint een gevaarlijke jacht vol spanning en geheimen.

programme.title: The Southerner
programme.desc: Het leven van de arme familie Tucker, die werkte als katoenplukkers en besloot om hun eigen grond te krijgen, maar de natuur is tegen hen.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 40, 41, 42
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programme.desc: Sartana wordt vals beschuldigd van een onmogelijke bankroof. Terwijl een premie op zijn hoofd staat, moet hij de echte daders vinden om zijn naam te zuiveren. Met hulp van zijn slimme, maar sjofele vriend Buddy Ben begint hij een gevaarlijke jacht op de waarheid. Kan hij zijn onschuld bewijzen voordat premiejagers hem te pakken krijgen?

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: Na per ongeluk de zoon van de cabaret danseres Kit Tilden te doden, probeert voormalig soldaat Yellowleg het goed te maken door haar begrafenisprocessie door gevaarlijk Apachegebied te escorteren. Samen met Billy en Turk moet hij Kit en de kist door vijandig land leiden om haar zoon te begraven bij haar overleden man.

programme.title: Django the Bastard
programme.desc: Een mysterieuze vreemdeling duikt op om wraak te nemen op voormalige Zuidelijke officieren die tijdens de Amerikaanse Burgeroorlog hun eigen eenheid verraadden, wat leidde tot een bloedige massaslachting. Zijn komst zaait angst terwijl hij hen één voor één confronteert met hun verleden.

programme.title: The Ruthless Four
programme.desc: In Nevada vinden goudzoeker Sam Cooper en zijn partner goud. Maar Sam's hebzuchtige partner begint te schieten op Sam die zijn toevlucht zoekt in de goudmijn.

programme.title: Life is Tough, Eh Providence
programme.desc: Een excentrieke premiejager genaamd Providence vangt en bevrijdt een crimineel om steeds weer dezelfde premie te innen in verschillende staten, totdat ze ontdekken dat een plaatselijke sheriff iets niet pluis is.

programme.title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
programme.desc: Na de Burgeroorlog sluit Jeff Sullivan zich aan bij Wells Fargo om bandieten te bestrijden, gedreven door wraak op Glenn Kovacks, de moordenaar van zijn vrouw. Met hulp van Kovacks’ stiefbroer Dan en premiejager Pancho volgt hij het spoor. De jacht eindigt in een bloedige confrontatie waarbij Glenns bende wordt vernietigd en Dan ternauwernood gered.

programme.title: Only the Valiant
programme.desc: Kapitein Richard Lance wordt door zijn mannen en vriendin ten onrechte verantwoordelijk gehouden voor de dood van de geliefde Lt. Holloway door een indianenmoord. Holloway wordt gedood terwijl hij een gevaarlijk indianenopperhoofd begeleidt naar de gevangenis van een ander fort. Het opperhoofd ontsnapt. Wetende dat hun fort in gevaar is voor een Indiaanse aanval, neemt Lance een kleine groep buitenbeentjes mee naar een verlaten nabijgelegen legerfort om een bergpas te verdedigen tegen de naderende Indiaanse aanval. Hun missie is tijd rekken tot versterkingen uit een ander fort aankomen. De mannen in deze kleine groep van ontevredenen, deserteurs, psychopaten en lafaards haten kapitein Lance en wensen hem dood. Tot hun verdriet zien de mannen in dat Lance's overlevingsinstincten, militaire kennis en leiderschap de enige kans zijn voor de groep om in leven te blijven.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Here's a tongue twister: Theresa, tuna, tangerine! In this episode, host Theresa Visintin picks her favourite letter, "T," and introduces us to scrumptious recipes using tuna and tangerine. Theresa loves tuna and Italian cuisine, so naturally she combines both to create a mouth-watering pasta with some savoury tomato, olive, and tuna sauce. Next, Theresa satisfies her sweet tooth with a decadent tangerine parfait! Using the sweet juice of the tangerine, Theresa creates gelatin, with a hint of orange liqueur. She tops it all off by whipping up a fluffy cream to complete this sweet treat. Then it's time for a real challenge: tuna and tangerine in one recipe!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this "H" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas decides to take on the unique flavours of halibut and horseradish. She starts with a perfectly prepared prosciutto wrapped halibut, pairing the buttery flavour of the fish with the saltiness of the cured meat. Throw in some dill potatoes and you've got a beautifully balanced dish. Next up, Chef Lauren show us how to make a delightful roast beef dip with a zesty horseradish sauce using carrots, vinegar, mayo and a little lemon. Finally, she is challenged to make a dish that combines both ingredients, and does she ever deliver!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this letter "P" challenge, Chef Robert Jewell showcases his vegetarian skills using pecans and peppers. Despite his cowboy roots, Robert shows us he can kick it with vegetarians by cooking up a juicy meatless "meatloaf" using pecans. But, no "meatloaf" would be complete without a gravy! Robert fries up earthy portobello mushrooms before adding a special ingredient to thicken the gravy, you guessed it -- pecans! Now, on to peppers. Robert doubles up, using both the vegetable and seasoning, to make a delicious red pepper coulis with herb and pepper crusted beef tenderloin. Robert goes a little nuts when he prepares his final recipe using both pecans and peppers.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Cheese or chocolate? Why not both! In this "C" challenge, host Theresa Visintin takes on both decadent ingredients. But first, she shows us that being cheesy is easy, especially when you stuff chicken breast with creamy goat's cheese and finely diced apples. Theresa takes the flavour one step further by coating the stuffed chicken with sage, parmesan, and panko bread crumbs, then frying it to a crispy golden brown. Next, Theresa whips up a dessert fan favourite, the decadent and oh-so-irresistible dark chocolate lava cake. Finally, Theresa has an irresistible recipe using ooey gooey cheese and warm chocolate.

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: Endearing host Tyrone Edwards surprises South African-born Shameen Miller with the results of her DNA test. Shameen cooks a meal that combines her two cultures and shares it with her family.

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: Host Tyrone Edwards shocks Andrea Titus with her DNA results. Blending her two cultures onto one plate, Andrea then cooks up a delicious and revealing meal for her family.

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: Host Tyrone Edwards reveals to Laird Hercules that his DNA includes other ancestry besides Guyanese. In the DNA Dinners kitchen, he cooks up a delicious meal that combines his known and newfound cultures.

programme.title: DNA Dinners
programme.desc: Mary Bosco is Italian, but Host Tyrone Edwards surprises her by revealing that her DNA test includes roots from other places. Mary cooks a special meal for her family that combines her two cultures.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: For this "N" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas works with noodles and nectarines. For her first dish, Lauren cooks up a breaded nectarine and mozzarella stack. Talking technique, she shows us how to cut nectarines into rounds. She does the same with some soft mozzarella and then walks us through the art of a balsamic reduction. For the noodles, Chef Lauren puts an elegant twist on your childhood favourite with a lobster mac and cheese. She spares no flavours, adding fried bacon, garlic, cayenne pepper, mustard powder, and even dry vermouth. This is no ordinary noodle dish. But now for the real challenge! Chef Lauren works with the noodles and nectarines.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Culinary expert Theresa Visintin picks the letter "B" and must combine beef with buttermilk for her challenge. But first, she works with the ingredients separately. Silky buttermilk lends itself perfectly to Theresa's battered blooming onion recipe. Using the biggest onion she can find, Theresa skillfully slices from the root down, ensuring it will bloom into a beautiful flower. She coats the Vidalia onion in egg, buttermilk and smoky spiced flour, before deep frying it. Next up, it's time for beef to get the Theresa treatment, as she prepares a crowd favourite- smoky, juicy, fall-off-thebone baked beef brisket. With the perfect balance of sweet and spicy, this meal will make you look forward to leftovers...if there are any! Now for the challenge - Theresa skillfully blends beef with buttermilk in a recipe that will tempt your taste buds.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: After picking "M" for this episode's challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas decides to make meal magic using maple and mahi-mahi. She starts by combining chestnut and quinoa to create a mouth-watering medley, rich in flavour and texture. Chef Lauren adds shiitake mushrooms and drizzles the dish with a balsamic vinegar, maple syrup and rosemary dressing. Next up, she steams Mahi-mahi with red chilies and lemongrass, this savoury spice is a heavenly combination with an invigorating aroma. For the challenge, Chef Lauren seamlessly introduces both maple and mahimahi into one flavourful fusion.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing; it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna; layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent truffle oil and sour cream.

programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: For this "N" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas works with noodles and nectarines. For her first dish, Lauren cooks up a breaded nectarine and mozzarella stack. Talking technique, she shows us how to cut nectarines into rounds. She does the same with some soft mozzarella and then walks us through the art of a balsamic reduction. For the noodles, Chef Lauren puts an elegant twist on your childhood favourite with a lobster mac and cheese. She spares no flavours, adding fried bacon, garlic, cayenne pepper, mustard powder, and even dry vermouth. This is no ordinary noodle dish. But now for the real challenge! Chef Lauren works with the noodles and nectarines.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Culinary expert Theresa Visintin picks the letter "B" and must combine beef with buttermilk for her challenge. But first, she works with the ingredients separately. Silky buttermilk lends itself perfectly to Theresa's battered blooming onion recipe. Using the biggest onion she can find, Theresa skillfully slices from the root down, ensuring it will bloom into a beautiful flower. She coats the Vidalia onion in egg, buttermilk and smoky spiced flour, before deep frying it. Next up, it's time for beef to get the Theresa treatment, as she prepares a crowd favourite- smoky, juicy, fall-off-thebone baked beef brisket. With the perfect balance of sweet and spicy, this meal will make you look forward to leftovers...if there are any! Now for the challenge - Theresa skillfully blends beef with buttermilk in a recipe that will tempt your taste buds.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: After picking "M" for this episode's challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas decides to make meal magic using maple and mahi-mahi. She starts by combining chestnut and quinoa to create a mouth-watering medley, rich in flavour and texture. Chef Lauren adds shiitake mushrooms and drizzles the dish with a balsamic vinegar, maple syrup and rosemary dressing. Next up, she steams Mahi-mahi with red chilies and lemongrass, this savoury spice is a heavenly combination with an invigorating aroma. For the challenge, Chef Lauren seamlessly introduces both maple and mahimahi into one flavourful fusion.

programme.title: Dropped S7 - "Survival Mode"
programme.desc: In the season premiere, brothers Chris and Casey Keefer are back in the Saskatchewan bushland to test their survival skills…and it might be their last time. They are desperate to find a safe spot for shelter, and clash over their first catch.

programme.title: Dropped S7 - "Game Plan"
programme.desc: With base camp set up and the cold setting in, Chris and Casey must find food…fast. Their energy levels are depleting as they begin their hunt for moose. As time ticks on, the brothers must think on their feet to find food…or risk going hungry.

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Sniper Attack"
programme.desc: Military snipers are trained in a variety of skills: detection, stalking, camouflage, infiltration, special reconnaissance and target acquisition. Bottom line, a ton of cool shooting and science for Nick and Laura to explore!

programme.title: Survival Science S1 - "Surviving a Lightning Strike"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 Surviving a Lightning Strike
programme.desc: Laura and Nick travel to a state-of-the-art Direct Effects Lightning Test Lab. With some “explosive” experiments, they’ll determine the power lightning and how it behaves? And they’ll find out how can hunters and fishermen best protect themselves?

programme.title: Survivorman S3 - "Norway Part 2"
programme.desc: Struggling down slick Norwegian slopes with 65 pounds of gear, an exhausted Les Stroud fights through his most difficult ten-day mission yet.

programme.title: Survivorman S3 - "Papua New Guinea"
programme.desc: Sick and plagued by parasites, Les Stroud battles torrential rain in Papua New Guinea before abandoning survival for a rare tribal celebration.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S1 - "Meet Island Air"
programme.desc: Veteran bush pilot Bob Stanford risks everything to save hunters struggling to stay alive in a remote area of Kodiak.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive S2 - "The Rescue"
programme.desc: Low on food, the five stars must rescue a "bleeding" expert before tackling a river assault course. One more celebrity is cut from the team.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive S2 - "The Forest"
programme.desc: Deep in the forest, the stars drink dung fluid and navigate a canyon waterfall. Tensions boil over before a terrifying 200ft rock face descent.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive S2 - "The Coast"
programme.desc: The final four build rafts to cross shark-infested waters and face a midnight ambush. Only three stars will survive the coast to reach the final.

programme.title: The Trail S2 - "Camp Chores"
programme.desc: No big game, but the storm is here. Laramy fights the rain and snow in a race for shelter.

programme.title: The Trail S2 - "Howling at the Moon"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Howling at the Moon
programme.desc: A surprise encounter yields a feast. Laramy claims his meat and prepares for the trail ahead.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Fourth Dimension"
programme.desc: Fourth of July in Montana – Flathead Lake is where the party is at. But with the heat tempers flare and the free flowing alcohol combines to make a dangerous situation.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Behind The Shed"
programme.desc: When the game ranges are opened up for Antler Shed Hunting its all hands on deck for the Montana Game Wardens. Reports of Bears, Mountain Lions and lost hunters keep the wardens busy.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Fun in The Sun"
programme.sub-title: S05 : E08 Fun in The Sun
programme.desc: When Jet skies get too close to boats things can turn dangerous. And Warden Bryan Golie questions an angler in search for the truth.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S1 - "The Rick Collins Story"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 The Rick Collins Story
programme.desc: This week on Trip Gone Bad, a father and son set out on a cliff side sheep hunt, but one slip could mean life or death in this remote and unforgiving area.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S1 - "Leming Bear Attack"
programme.desc: This week, we'll learn the harrowing tale of a father's desperate attempt to save his son's life from a grizzly bear attack while out hunting together.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S1 - "Season Recap"
programme.desc: This week, we take a look back at our season's survival stories with a more in-depth look with the help of former Army Special Forces soldier, Terry Schappert.

programme.title: Dropped S7 - "Wind Burnt"
programme.desc: Saskatchewan’s bitter cold and unforgiving wind makes for brutal days and nights for Chris and Casey. A rainstorm adds more difficulty and discomfort. Mentally drained and hungry, the brothers must try new tactics to find food and warmth.

programme.title: Dropped S7 - "Brotherly Love"
programme.desc: The lack of hunting opportunities have drained Chris and Casey’s patience. Arguments ensue when they disagree over staying put, or portaging to a new lake. Signs of a bear remind the brothers that they must remain focused in order to stay alive.

programme.title: Dropped S7 - "Hunger Pains"
programme.desc: Symptoms of starvation have set in for Chris and Casey, who haven’t eaten in days. When they cross paths with a grouse, the unexpected happens. Frustration peaks as the temperatures drop. The brothers set up a new camp, but will it help the hunt?

programme.title: The Hunt for Monster Bass S1 - "Winter Largemouth"
programme.desc: Host Ott DeFoe hunts down double-digit Largemouth Bass in the dead of winter in Tennessee.

programme.title: Emergency S1 - "Religious Fervour"
programme.desc: Massive crowds gather at Allahabad’s Maha Kumbh Mela and Manila’s Black Nazarene, creating major healthcare challenges. Thousands of medical personnel and volunteers are deployed to keep people safe.

programme.title: Emergency S1 - "Big Cities"
programme.desc: Osaka, Japan, struggles with increasing emergency calls from its aging population. In fast-paced Greater Mexico City, home to 20 million people, medical services face overwhelming demand.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S1 - "Fight or Flight"
programme.desc: While on a routine sightseeing flight, a massive storm has the pilots fighting to keep control of the craft and keep their passengers safe.

programme.title: Alaska's Ultimate Bush Pilots S1 - "Deadman's Survival"
programme.desc: Island Air battles time and elements, to rescue a group trapped in Deadman's Bay.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive S1 - "The Storm"
programme.desc: Torrential storms and high-pressure river rapids push the group to the brink. They must build shelters and hunt fish to avoid being sent home.

programme.title: Bear Grylls: Mission Survive S1 - "The Cave"
programme.desc: Surviving on tarantulas, the remaining six trek through dark caves to find a pig carcass while facing crocodile-infested waters downstream

programme.title: Buccaneers and Bones S1 - "Rising Tides"
programme.desc: Off the coast of Belize, the group of anglers continue their pursuit of bonefish & tarpon. Michael Keaton & Zach Gilford chase tarpon, while Bill Klyn & Yvon Chouinard are after bone. We also share a boat with Aaron Adams & Tom McGuane.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S2 - "After The Fall"
programme.desc: A rock-climbing disaster hurtles climber Craig DeMartino 100 feet down a granite cliff. A shattered heap of broken bones, Craig clings to life. In a split second, Craig’s life becomes an inspiring fight to survive.

programme.title: Fight to Survive S2 - "A River's Grasp"
programme.desc: In an isolated mountain river, Fisherman Dean Ririe becomes hopelessly trapped under a boulder in water up to his neck. In icy waters that should kill a man, Dean fights for his life miles from help.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S2 - "Strike out"
programme.desc: Mike Johnson crosses the ice to fish with his brother Rick despite lingering tensions. Tim Adams returns to work with a new partner.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S2 - "The Good, Bad, and the Ugly"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 The Good, Bad, and the Ugly
programme.desc: Tim pairs with an old friend to cash in on a hot market. Rick and Mike have a truck on the way, but face delivery doubts.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S2 - "Never Say Never"
programme.desc: Mike and Tim reunite on the water after a decade apart. Jedd wraps up winter projects and preps his crew for the next season.

programme.title: Bottom Feeders S2 - "Clam Lake"
programme.desc: Rick tries to land a contract to fish Clam Lake. When he is denied, Tim seizes the opportunity.

programme.title: Dropped S7 - "White Out"
programme.desc: With still no big game in sight, Chris and Casey are forced to rely on fishing for food. The cold temperatures have slowed down the fish, creating challenges. When Mother Nature brings a brutal snow storm, the brothers are tested like never before.

programme.title: Dropped S7 - "Motherly Love"
programme.desc: After weeks of trying to survive in Saskatchewan, Chris and Casey have yet to kill big game. Time is running out as the bear begin to hibernate. Mental willpower is wearing thin. But a message from back home changes everything.

programme.title: Dropped S7 - "Refueled"
programme.desc: A turn of events lifts the brothers’ spirits, but creates a huge hurdle they must overcome as they enter a new race against the clock. Chris and Casey reflect on the challenges they have faced so far, and the challenges that still lie ahead.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Above & Beyond"
programme.desc: Wardens often go the extra mile to investigate a report of illegal activity, help a hunter or protect landowner rights. This week Wardens go that extra mile with an unexpected outcome.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Thrill Kill"
programme.desc: In 2012 The small community of Whitefish Montana was shocked by the useless killing of over 20 deer. Region 1 Wardens think outside the box to put a stop to this heinous crime.

programme.title: Wardens S5 - "Invasive Species"
programme.desc: Protecting Montana Waters from Aquatic Invasive Species is a top priority for Montana FWP. But when AIS check stations are set up in Region 1 and 3 it's up to the Wardens to educate the public.

programme.title: Emergency S1 - "Ibiza"
programme.desc: Ibiza’s medical services face heavy strain during tourist season, often due to late-night excesses. In Thailand, nurses work tirelessly at the Full Moon Party to keep international revelers safe.

programme.title: Emergency S1 - "Carnival"
programme.desc: Rio’s Carnival—a week of samba and celebrations—often sends many to the ER. At Barcelona’s La Mercè Festival, first aid stations care for the injured, sick, and intoxicated.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "British Columbia"

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "California Desert"

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Berlin"

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Ibiza"
programme.desc: DJ-producer Carly Foxx travels to the clubbing capital of the world to inspire her music track and discovers Ibiza’s alternative spiritual side.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Europe"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx looks back at her journey to the music dance capitals of Europe to inspire her final track.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "United Kingdom"

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "Los Angeles"

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "LA County"

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s longest and most luxurious railways"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Riding America’s longest and most luxurious railways
programme.desc: This leg of the trip combines the longest continuous rail journey in America with a stay on the country’s most luxurious train.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s highest altitude and most scenic railways"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Riding America’s highest altitude and most scenic railways

programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Riding America’s longest ferry

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "North Carolina"

programme.title: Vengeance Valley
programme.desc: The sons of a Colorado cattle baron, one biological and the other adopted, resent one another and fight for control of their father's cattle empire.

programme.title: Riders of the Deadline
programme.desc: The 50th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy films finds Hoppy in a vengeful mood. When his good friend Tim Mason is unjustly sent to jail and then killed when trying to escape, Hoppys bitterness gets him drummed out of the Texas Rangers. With the help of his pals California Carson and Jimmy Rogers, he sets out to expose the real culprits and clear Tims name. The usual cast is here, including William Boyd as Hoppy, plus Andy Clyde, Jimmy Rogers, and in one of his earliest roles, Robert Mitchum.

programme.title: The Gunman from Bodie
programme.desc: The Rough Riders, a popular group that thrilled audiences in the early 1940s, are after a gang of rustlers in this B-western from Hollywood's Poverty Row. Starring Buck Jones, Tim McCoy, and Raymond Hatton, this movie features everything from lawmen going undercover to the Rough Riders looking after an orphaned baby! Also, be on the lookout for the beautiful Christine McIntyre, who would go on to appear in several of the Three Stooges shorts for Colombia Pictures.

programme.title: Red Ryder: Ride, Ryder, Ride!
programme.desc: Red Ryder encounters bandits trying to hold up the stagecoach carrying the owner of the Devil's Hole newspaper, Libby Brooks and her brother Gerry. Red successfully drives off the attackers but becomes embroiled in further conflict, leading to a duel that nearly claims his life.

programme.title: Fighting Fury
programme.desc: A THRILLING TALE OF REVENGE AND REDEMPTION! Based on the story Triple Cross for Danger by the widely lauded Western author Walter J. Coburn, Fighting Fury is a thrilling take on the Western revenge drama. Portraying both a father and his son, star of silent and sound cowboy adventure films, Jack Hoxie (Trouble Busters, Law and Lawless) exudes the classic American rustic charm that still defines the genre. The film spins the yarn of Clay Hill Jr. (Hoxie), a Spanish-American boy raised by a Mexican servant who vows bloody vengeance on three malicious ranchers after they murder his parents and turn his life upside down. Featuring fine supporting performances from genre heavies Helen Holmes, Buck Conners and Western mainstay Fred Kohler.

programme.title: Springtime in the Sierras
programme.desc: Ads for this Roy Rogers classic roared HEAD FOR THE MUSICAL HILLS...ROY IS GUNNIN' FOR THRILLS! And thrills are what you'll get when you watch this fun, action packed B-Western from Republic Pictures. There's some great comic relief from Andy Devine and Chester Conklin, two of Hollywood's all-time greats. This old-fashioned shoot-'em-up was directed by William Witney, who would go on to direct many of television's top western sagas, including Bonanza, Wagon Train, and The Wild, Wild West.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat Gallagher and his sidekick Stoney Crockett are Secret Service agents in the Old West, dispatched by the government to investigate crimes threatening the young nation. In this episode, the G-Men are sent to the Ozarks to track down gold stolen from the U.S. Government. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: An outlaw gang is stealing gold from Chinese placer miners, then driving off their claims with outrageous taxes. Because they're Chinese, they can't sue the local government agents. With Stoney posing as a Chinese miner and Pat pretending to be a representative of an Eastern engineering company, the U.S. government tries to bring an end to the careers of the outlaw gang and crooked state government agents.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney take time out from their duties to try and collect the bounty posted on a legendary golden wolf that roams the Colorado foothills. A couple of wolf hunters don't take kindly to a pair of amateur hunters horning in on their range and attempt to drive the G-Men away before they can capture or kill their quarry.

programme.title: Cowboy G-Men
programme.desc: Pat and Stoney travel to Wyoming to oversee a land opening and end up playing nursemaid to a pair of identical twin pranksters and a kooky Chinese cook. Meanwhile, a trio of outlaws are pursuing the twins seeking information they possess. Starring Russell Hayden, Jackie Coogan.

programme.title: Petticoat Junction
programme.desc: Kate hires Herby to work as an assistant manager at the hotel, causing Uncle Joe to fear for his position. Uncle Joe Carson: Edgar Buchanan. Betty Jo Bradley: Linda Henning. Kate Bradley: Bea Benaderet. Sam Drucker: Frank Cady. Also starring Pat Woodall and Jeannine Riley. Series created by Paul Henning. Episode first aired in 1963.
